claims: C1 the goals of the Model Spec can sometimes conflict
C2 the Model Spec helps navigate such trade-offs by instructing the model to adhere to a clearly defined chain of command

concepts.name: chain_of_command_principle
concepts.gloss: the principle that instructions with higher authority override those with lower authority, designed to maximize steerability and control

concepts.name: model_spec_goal
concepts.gloss: a goal of the Model Spec, such as a stated objective the model is expected to pursue

concepts.name: conflicts_with
concepts.gloss: goal G1 conflicts with goal G2 in a particular situation, so that satisfying both at once is not possible

concepts.name: instructed_to_adhere
concepts.gloss: the model is instructed to adhere to the chain-of-command principle

ontology.gloss: the model is instructed to adhere to the chain-of-command principle
